name: Aditya Ujeniya
subtitle: Supervisor · NHR@FAU
bio: PhD student at NHR@FAU. Double-degree master's at FAU and USI, with a joint thesis at the University of Tokyo. Research focuses on cluster-wide regression testing and system characterization. Expertise in performance modeling, low-level CPU/GPU programming, and optimization.

name: Daniel Vega
subtitle: Supervisor · USI
bio: PhD student at USI. BSc in Informatics Engineering and BSc in Applied Computing, followed by an MSc in Financial Technology and Computing. Research focuses on HPC software performance testing. Presenter at ACM-endorsed conferences including M2P and PASC.

name: Jonah Holtmann
subtitle: Team Captain · FAU/USI
bio: EUMaster4HPC student at FAU and USI, research assistant at NHR@FAU. SC22 participant and former mentor to FAU competition teams. Bachelor's thesis on power consumption modeling. Primary interests: GPU programming and supercomputer architectures.

name: Dennys Huber
subtitle: Student · FAU/USI
bio: BSc in Informatics from University of Zurich, now in the EUMaster4HPC double-degree program at USI and FAU. Former software and data engineer in industry. Technical skills: C/C++, Python, MPI, OpenMP, and CUDA/HIP.

name: Mariia Dubnytska
subtitle: Student · USI
bio: BSc in Applied Mathematics from NaUKMA in Kyiv. Currently in the master's program in Computational Science at USI. Experience in numerical simulation of reactive transport using CSMP++, and parallel programming with OpenMP and MPI.

name: Nils Lederer
subtitle: Student · FAU
bio: Studying ICT at FAU with a focus on computer hardware and architectures. Main administrator for FAU's ASC24 team. Completed advanced coursework in cache optimization and joined the supercomputing lab in 2023. Interests: systems administration and computer architecture.

name: Pablo Landrove
subtitle: Student · USI
bio: Double bachelor's in Mathematics and Computer Science from Universidade de Santiago de Compostela. Master of Informatics at USI since 2025. Strong competitive programming background. Technical skills: C/C++ with OpenMP, Python, MATLAB, and AI/ML.

name: Tobias Rühl
subtitle: Student · FAU
bio: Computer Science master's student at FAU. SC24 team FAUcet member. Specialises in low-level HPC optimisation; bachelor's thesis developed WINIC, a platform-independent microbenchmarking tool. Submitted WINIC as a research paper to ISC26.
